Senses.Explanation: Not engaging the myriad conditions is the exhalation half of a paired saying about breath. Masters quote, reverse, question, and verse the paired saying “exhalation does not engage myriad conditions; inhalation does not dwell in the aggregates and realms.” The entry records this attested paired saying about breath, not every ordinary statement about avoiding circumstances.
